name: Teams and agents social card by notion.com
description: A 1200×630 white social card uses a centered vertical composition: a small black wordmark anchors the top, followed by an oversized two-line headline with a pale-blue rounded highlight around one phrase. A row of colorful illustrated circular avatars creates the visual bridge into a cropped grayscale product-interface image along the bottom, balancing stark black typography with playful accents and a light editorial rhythm.
